_comment: Cross-implementation conformance vectors for the Nex Rendezvous wire contract v1.
V3 SS15: a prior audit found an implementation labelled 'Noise' that was self-consistent
but not spec-conformant, because it had only ever been tested against another copy of
itself. Two implementations agreeing is not proof of correctness -- but two implementations
DISAGREEING is proof of a bug, and this file is how that gets caught automatically.
Neither the Go service nor the TypeScript client is the source of truth here. THIS FILE is.
Both sides assert against it. If your implementation produces different bytes, your
implementation is wrong; do not edit the vectors to match your code.
Regenerate only when the contract itself changes, and say so in the commit message.

publicDescriptor._fields: LP(v=1) LP(handle) LP(nodeId) LP(signPub) LParr(capabilities) LPn(issuedAt) LPn(expiresAt) LP(connectable)

contactDescriptor._fields: LP(v=1) LP(handle) LP(nodeId) LP(signPub) LP(noisePub) LParr(capabilities) LPcand(candidates) LPn(issuedAt) LPn(expiresAt)
contactDescriptor._note: The second candidate deliberately contains '|' in both kind and host. Under the pre-amendment flattened "kind|host|port" encoding this collided with contactDescriptorCollision below; under LPcand it must not.

contactDescriptorCollision._note: Amendment 1 regression guard. Identical to contactDescriptor except the second candidate splits 'weird|kind' / 'a|b' differently. Its signing input MUST differ; if the two are equal, candidate signing is malleable.
